findings.statement: Nested RPG Maker MZ runtime coexists with a four-source TypeScript domain/application/dto slice emitted as ES modules and declarations under frontend/js.
NW.js opens index.html; main.js loads local engine modules and plugins.js, then PluginManager loads unique active plugins before Scene_Boot.
63 plugin entries contain 46 active but 44 unique names; duplicate PKD_SimpleQuestSystem/Coreto_TpEvents entries are deduplicated. Coreto_SQS_menu_patch queries a mismatched parameter name.
TypeScript, Jest/SWC, ESLint, Prettier and NW.js workflows are configured; 19 test files cover modules, plugins, data, generators, assets and progression. None were run.
Map/free-ID tools are read-only; XML and troop generators write outputs; unused-assets is dry-run by default but has report and confirmed move modes.
game.rmmzproject marks 1.10.0 while local runtime files mark 1.8.1; runtime compatibility remains unvalidated.
